summary: V3-08 repair accepted. The candidate repairs the trusted finalizer failure of Actions run 35577033059: the release job failed at step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' after 26m09s (08:39:14 -> 09:05:23 UTC) while the product/privacy/cost gates and APK steps passed — a slow-emulator E2E timeout exhaustion. The fix increases every E2E timing budget with documented rationale: COLD_START_GRACE_MS 300s -> 450s (beyond the documented 240s React Native cold start, within the Demarrer timeout), waitFor('Demarrer') 600s -> 900s (accommodates one force-stop + relaunch cycle with a fresh 240s cold start), all other golden-path waitFor timeouts 120s -> 300s (crash-relaunch cold-start headroom), emulator boot timeout 300s -> 420s, and package-manager settle 15s -> 30s. The contract test was updated to match (graceMs upper bound 600_000 -> 900_000, Demarrer waitFor string 600000 -> 900000). The delta is confined to scripts/e2e-android.js, scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh and __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts; zero product code (src/, app/), governance, directives, workflows or release state changed, so V3-01..V3-07 invariants cannot regress. Trusted verification exit code is 0 (typecheck PASS, 453/453 tests PASS in 22 suites, privacy 71/71 PASS, cost 21/21 PASS, expo export android PASS, prebuild PASS, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 19m12s). Independent re-runs confirm typecheck, 453 tests, privacy 71, cost 21, node --check and bash -n all pass; the forbidden-regression scan of added lines is clean. Limitation documented: the raw step-7 logs of run 35577033059 are not directly readable from this environment (GitHub Actions logs endpoint returns 403 without admin rights, no factory token present), but the public API confirms the exact failure point (release job step 7, 26m09s duration, gates passed) and the candidate directly targets the timeout-exhaustion failure mode. The definitive verification is the next trusted finalizer dispatch, which only the trusted shell can trigger.
